description: An expander for Quad Algorithmic Rhythm, placed immediately to its right, giving each of 18 steps its own chance of firing.

params.text: Applies these probabilities to that track of the Quad Algorithmic Rhythm; unlit, the track is left alone.
Sets the chance that a beat falling on that step fires, 0% to 100%.
Scales the voltage at that step's probability input, -100% to +100%, before it is added to the step's own setting.
Adds that step to the track's probability group: if the earliest step of the group does not fire, no later member fires either, otherwise each uses its own chance.
Switches the probabilities from following steps to following beats, so they apply to the 1st beat, 2nd beat and so on whichever steps those fall on.

inputs.text: Voltage sets the chance of that step firing through its own attenuverter; 10V at full attenuverter is certainty.

notes: A QAR Grid Control expander placed immediately to the right of this module replaces the 18 probability settings with the shape drawn in its grid.
